description: A message provider that answers with the message and a 500: today's verifier reads the body of an asynchronous message's reply whatever its status, and passes; janus verify fails a reply that is not a 2xx, as an http hook's always is (ADR 0046)
source: staged plan S1.7; pact_verifier's verify_message_from_provider, which checks no status, where verify_sync_message_from_provider requires a success
